scope: New unified fixed mock launcher only; no native execution or admission

delegations.role: reply-only design review and supplied-source review

excludedFromDelegateSourceReview: copied ownership, transport and lease helpers
reviewCoverage.limitation: Later parent changes were reviewed by the parent and verified by capture; delegates did not independently review the final complete source tree

parentDispositions: Corrected initial peer draft: initialize has no required protocolVersion; response omits jsonrpc to match the frozen parser
Initial lease now uses strict nonce/sequence/timestamp parsing and fails on missing or stale receipts
Unit preflight now requires completed returnCode 0 plus explicit not-found; timeout already refused
Unique per-case directories intentionally reject pre-existing home paths; rerun into a fresh cohort
Peer environment now explicitly limited to PATH LC_ALL HOME CODEX_HOME TMPDIR
Heartbeat writer is joined before stdin is closed; unexpected write failures remain failures; no error suppression added
Peer timeout now explicitly kills and waits its owned child and records timedOut before returning failure; manager deadline can still terminate main first and that cannot pass
Coordinator waits for independent ready and held Windows handles before release; it does not wait for host completion
Observer starts before host launch and holds live worker/peer/leaf pidfds before peer release
Unit garbage collection is terminal metadata unavailable; never infer Result success from not-found. Actual wait exit0, peer receipt/reap0 and independent lifecycle witnesses required
Record exact prepared service argv, reject terminal query timeout, validate profile and watchdog90, retain future native candidate only as unexecuted reference

guardReview.clean-code-guard: Parent reviewed new ownership and failure paths; copied helpers retain their original scoped limitations

guardReview.docs-guard: Report separates protocol refusal from cleanup completion, explicitly records GC metadata absence and lists open admission/privacy/L2 work
